description: Terrace segment pieces, not a standalone whole-house variant. Files follow <placement>_level_<n>.nbt: a placement prefix of left_ or right_ marks an END CAP; ANY other prefix (center_, and future interiors like bakeryfront_) is an interior piece. The TERRACE residential arranger composes a row as LEFT cap + N interior pieces + RIGHT cap, placed flush (shared walls by construction). This folder intentionally has no plain level_<n>.nbt, so the pieces never enter the normal HOUSE variant pool; they are only reachable through the piece index (BuildingAvailability.availablePieces) and the row_house:<piece> forced-variant ids.
